Publication must be an immutable role-local create-only artifact keyed by a deterministic result_id so duplicate replay and lost create responses reconcile by reading that exact own path.
not_self_certifying: claims needing fresh external-world facts not already reducible to embedded verifiable evidence
claims requiring all-role completeness or current dynamic pool membership
arbitrary external side effects whose sink does not consume the same durable result_id idempotently
required_verifier_behavior: recompute deterministic local predicate from artifact and embedded evidence
reject unsupported external-fact or all-role scope
treat identical deterministic result_id replay as the same publication
on lost create response read the exact own immutable result path before retrying
